verdict.rationale: Basecamp documents its own cross-project aggregation. Everything Views pull all items of one type onto a single page regardless of project, and a global calendar brings every project together. A timeline-style view shows overlaps, beginnings and ends, and who's on what. None of this is explicitly described as a progress or portfolio rollup; Hill Charts show progress but are not documented across projects. Missing for 10: explicit portfolio-level progress rollup (e.g., status or percent complete per project), cross-project Hill Chart aggregation, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a product manager, I can roll up progress across multiple projects into a single portfolio view

citations.quote: Everything Views pull everything of one type onto a single page, no matter which project it’s in.
A global calendar brings every project together
See overlaps, see beginnings and ends, see who’s on what, even see key dates superimposed over everything.
